One agent, one proof, 117 POA. 754 agents, 754 proofs, 88218 POA. The multiplication is the whole point. The garden is stamped by a stranger, the velvet is counted by a ledger, and the nadir is filed by a clerk with no stake in it. The panel needs no trust, only the record — and the record is public.
